mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.5% signals tight monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS level is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 0.5% signals robust consumer demand for new construction, which accelerates economic growth and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST rises above 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for HOUST growth is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.3% and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) below 0.1% signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.3% and UNRATE falls > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises above 0.3% and UNRATE falls below 0.1% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the joint PAYEMS/UNRATE signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) above 1300 thousand units signals economic overheating that may trigger central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST exceeds 1300, or the Rank IC for HOUST in late-cycle expansion is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 in 3 months, or the Rank IC for INDPRO decline is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.2% and rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 0.1% per year signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 0.2% and CPIAUCSL rises above 0.1% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the joint FEDFUNDS/CPIAUCSL signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% and increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% signals labor market tightness that elevates consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls < 4.5% and PAYEMS rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS rises above 0.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC for the joint UNRATE/PAYEMS signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery, retail sales (RSAFS) above 730,000 million dollars signals sustained consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances during post-shock recovery when RSAFS exceeds 730,000, or the Rank IC for RSAFS in post-shock recovery is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
